feedback: The app crashes every time I try to upload a photo. I've tried reinstalling but the issue persists.
Login is extremely slow — takes 15+ seconds on a good connection. Very frustrating.
Love the new dashboard redesign! Much cleaner and easier to navigate.
I've been billed twice for the same month and customer support hasn't resolved it after 2 weeks.
The search feature doesn't work at all. Typing in the search box does nothing.
Notifications stopped working after the latest update. I'm missing important alerts.
Really impressed with the AI recommendations — they feel surprisingly accurate.
The mobile app is way too slow on older devices. Everything lags and stutters.
Can't export my data to CSV. The button is there but nothing downloads.
Onboarding tutorial was super helpful. Got up and running in 10 minutes!
The app crashes when I switch between tabs quickly. Happens every time.
Password reset emails are not arriving. Checked spam, nothing there.
Charts on the analytics page take forever to load. Sometimes they just don't load.
I love the integrations with Slack and Google Sheets. Saves me so much time.
The dark mode is broken — some text is invisible against the dark background.
Billing dashboard shows incorrect totals. The numbers don't add up at all.
Search results are completely irrelevant to what I'm typing. Needs a lot of work.
App keeps logging me out randomly. Have to sign in multiple times a day.
The customer support team was incredibly helpful and resolved my issue quickly!
Performance has degraded significantly since the last major update. Everything is slower.
Uploading large files always fails above 50MB. No error message, just hangs.
The new filter UI is confusing — took me 10 minutes to figure out how to use it.
I can't believe how buggy this is. Three crashes in one session. Unacceptable.
Collaboration features are excellent. My whole team switched from the competitor.
The app doesn't work at all offline. Even read-only features require internet.
Pricing is way too high for what you get. Competitors offer more for less.
Login with Google is broken — redirects to a 404 page every time.
Getting 'Network Error' constantly. Have tried on 3 different networks.
Would love a bulk export feature. Currently have to export one by one — very tedious.
The report generation feature is fantastic. Saves our team hours every week.
Two-factor authentication is broken — verification codes aren't arriving via SMS.
Data sync between desktop and mobile is unreliable. Sometimes days out of date.
The UI is gorgeous but the UX needs work. Beautiful but hard to use.
App crashes on startup on iOS 18. Completely unusable since the update.
Customer service took 5 days to respond and still hasn't solved my problem.
The API documentation is outdated and missing critical endpoint details.
Webhook integrations are not firing reliably. About 30% of events are missed.
Love the product overall. Small bugs aside, it's the best tool in this space.
The mobile keyboard covers input fields and there's no way to scroll. Very annoying.
Team permissions are broken — editors can access admin settings they shouldn't.
App randomly freezes and requires force-close. Losing unsaved work constantly.
The calendar integration with Google Calendar is seamless. Well done!
Can't add team members despite being on the Team plan. Getting a permissions error.
Loading times are atrocious. 8-10 seconds to load a simple list view.
The search indexing seems wrong — searching for exact phrases returns zero results.
I was charged after I cancelled my subscription. Need an immediate refund.
Push notifications are delayed by hours. Completely defeats their purpose.
The onboarding flow is confusing for non-technical users. Needs simplification.
Great product but the mobile experience feels like an afterthought.
File attachments over 10MB fail to send with a cryptic error message.
